description: A large white and blue airliner with a dark cabin window line and a small round emblem sits on a dim theatre stage under hanging spotlights. Lettering on the fuselage reads UNITED STATES. A rack of dark uniform jackets stands at the left, and small flags and scattered paper lie on the wooden stage floor. Rows of empty seats fill the foreground. The painting is loose, dark and oil-like, and it fills the frame edge to edge.
